settings.heading: Join Over 15,000+ Happy Dog Owners Worldwide
Watching Your Dog Struggle… And Not Knowing What to Do
settings.text:
It's one of the hardest things to watch. Your dog limping, hesitating to stand up, looking at you like they need help, and you start wondering if you're doing enough.

A torn CCL is the most common knee injury in dogs and a leading cause of hind-leg lameness. The usual surgery often costs thousands of dollars per leg, followed by weeks of crate rest, anaesthesia risk and no guarantee it holds.

For many dogs, vets see conservative management as a valid first step: rest, weight control and supportive bracing to steady the joint while it heals. That's what this brace is made for. It's not a miracle or a replacement for your vet, but a real way to support recovery and protect the other leg too.

settings.heading: Support Their Recovery — Gently, Safely, at Home
settings.text:
That’s exactly why Blomar works when the others didn’t. Blomar isn’t a compression sleeve. It’s a dual-leg hinged harness — meaning it has a real mechanical
hinge at the stifle joint that controls movement and limits the painful wobble of an unstable knee. And it
has an integrated harness body that anchors across your dog’s chest and back, so the brace stays
exactly where you put it. No slipping. No migration. No Velcro giving out by week two.
The other thing most single-leg braces completely ignore: your dog’s other knee is now at risk.
According to the American College of Veterinary Surgeons, 40–60% of dogs that tear one CCL will tear
the other within a year. Blomar supports both hind knees at once — in one brace, in one purchase,
from day one.

settings.heading: How It Works
settings.text:
A Blomar™ DUAL-LEG KNEE BRACE HARNESS works by stabilizing the injured knee joint so the dog can move with less pain while the leg heals.

Here’s the basic process:

  • Supports the knee joint
    The brace wraps around the dog’s leg and holds the knee in a safer position, reducing instability from ACL/CCL tears or arthritis.
  • Reduces pressure and pain
    By limiting harmful movement, it decreases strain on ligaments, swelling, and joint pain.
  • Improves mobility
    Dogs can walk more normally because the brace helps distribute weight and prevents the leg from collapsing.
  • Prevents further injury
    The support lowers the chance of worsening the tear or damaging the other leg from overcompensation.
  • Helps recovery at home
    It acts like a rehabilitation tool, allowing gradual healing and safer movement without immediate surgery in some cases.

settings.heading: Why Blomar™ Is Different
settings.text:
You've probably already tried one of the $12 Amazon sleeves. It slid off in 10 minutes. The velcro gave out by week two. Now you think braces don't work.

They don't — if they're just compression sleeves with nothing holding them in place.

Blomar is different in two ways that matter. First: it has a hinged joint that stabilizes the stifle — the exact joint that's unstable in a CCL tear. Second: it has an integrated harness body that anchors across your dog's chest and back, so it stays on. All day. Every day.

And it supports both hind knees at once — because your dog's other knee is now statistically the most vulnerable joint in their body, and no single-leg brace does anything about that.
